name: Erika Murasaki
source:
Likes: Politeness and manners, people
Dislikes: Rudeness, perverted men

Erika is a princess. For real. She appeared in Kazami School as a transfer student in order to learn how to understand people better and become a worthy monarch in the future. She is polite and responsive to all, except for [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki[/url], who was careless enough to accidentally grab her breast. After such a horrible event Erika took a dislike to this guy. A difficult character is common among the princesses, but Yoshiyuki couldn't even imagine what kind of a princess she actually is.
